calculation.fx_rate_source: User-configured fixed paper simulation rate; not a live FX quote
calculation.basis_risk_summary: London City Airport (EGLC), 10.6km from the business. Airport observations and gridded business-location weather can diverge. Station fallback/correction clauses in the original rules still apply; no numerical basis-risk score is claimed. Sizing is capped to the isolated daily_max_temperature contribution (£77.56), holding the other weather inputs fixed; it does not claim to cover the whole combined weather scenario. Contract resolves on 'daily_max_temperature' at 'London, UK' via https://aviationweather.gov/api/data/metar?ids=EGLC&format=raw&date=2026-11-10T03:00:00Z&hours=30. If the pub suffers adverse weather (£2181.53 vs £2259.09 reference) AND the contract pays out, remaining downside is reduced from £77.56 to £0.38. However, if the pub loses revenue while the contract does not trigger (basis mismatch), combined revenue + hedge outcome worsens to £2181.37.
